meta.temperature_limitation: Temperature forecast is the next-day DAILY MEAN; no sub-daily temperature forecast and no Tmax forecast exist, so the IMD heatwave criterion is not evaluated. The frozen temperature HMM (171 training days, Jan-Jun 2024) has low skill: next-day MAE ~1.0 °C vs ~0.5 °C typical day-to-day change.
limitations: AQI values are computed by UrbanPulse with the CPCB NAQI sub-index method (24 h / 8 h rolling means, >=3 pollutants incl. PM) from OpenAQ hourly station data; they are not official CPCB bulletins.
Only 7 zones have an AQI HMM; other zones show an MRF spatial estimate (not a measurement) when an adjacent zone has measured input, otherwise unavailable.
OpenAQ CPCB data typically lags real time by 1-2 days; AQI forecast target times are relative to the latest measured hour, which may already be in the past.
Weather is Open-Meteo reanalysis/model analysis, not station measurement; the 15 zones map to only 8 distinct model grid cells, so several zones share identical weather.

Rainfall forecasts and heavy-rain alerts are disabled: the only rainfall HMMs (zones 4, 5, 10, 14) were trained on CAAQMS gauges, no live gauge feed exists, and reanalysis input failed validation. Current rainfall is shown from Open-Meteo reanalysis for all zones.

Temperature forecast is the next-day DAILY MEAN; no sub-daily temperature forecast and no Tmax forecast exist, so the IMD heatwave criterion is not evaluated. The frozen temperature HMM (171 training days, Jan-Jun 2024) has low skill: next-day MAE ~1.0 °C vs ~0.5 °C typical day-to-day change.
